Counsel for Applicant :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali,Bal Krishna Shukla,Gyanendra Pathak
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.144 of 2022, under Section 376, 307, 323, 504,
506, 498A Ipc & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Risia, District Bahraich.

entities.text: Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Risia, District Bahraich
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the informant was married to the son of the applicant in the year 2019 and sufficient dowry was given, however, the matrimonial family was not happy with the dowry and were demanding a car, and were harassing the informant.
The allegation against the applicant is that he had committed rape on her on various occasions.

It was stated that on Dhodhey vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172070597/
1 14.05.2022, the informant's husband performed a second marriage which was opposed by the informant and thereafter, the FIR was registered.
4. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that bald and scandalous allegations have been levelled against the entire matrimonial family; no time, place and date of the incident was disclosed with regard to the allegation against the applicant.

entities.text: Dhodhey vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Civil
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is father-in-law and is aged about 56 years.

The applicant has no criminal history except for two cases of the year 2010 that too under Section 363 & 366 IPC and Section 110G IPC.
5.
Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the nature of the allegations, prima-facie, scandalous allegation has been levelled against the entire family members that too after the second marriage was performed by the husband of the informant and there is no corroborative evidence to support the contention against the applicant, who is the father-in-law.
The applicant is in custody since 14.10.2022 and has no criminal antecedent, as such, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Dhodhey be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
